hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; case "$f" in "$d"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "$d" && case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f";; *) ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown --log-level warn "$f";; esac 2>/dev/null || true
